package.goal: Make provider.tool summaries for shell commands follow the new contract line: program plus at most two words, no wrapper, NAME=value cut, 60 characters, for both the Codex and the Claude adapter.
constraints: Only edit files under packages/cli/src/providers (adapters, shared helpers and their tests). Do not touch docs, fixtures, other packages, package.json or the lockfile. Existing tests must keep passing; adjust an existing assertion only where the new contract line in events.md changes the expected summary, and say which.
No new dependencies. No any. No comments unless explaining a non-obvious why. Do not run any claude or codex command. Tests must not start real providers (spawnReal is blocked under vitest anyway).
acceptance: A shared pure helper `shellSummary(command: string, cwd?: string): string` implements the shell-command summary rule of docs/contracts/events.md: strip one leading wrapper of the form `bash -lc`, `/usr/bin/bash -lc`, `sh -c` (with its surrounding single or double quotes), take the first line, keep the program and at most the next two whitespace-separated words, cut a word containing `=` to `NAME=…` (everything after the first `=` replaced by `…`), remove an absolute cwd prefix from words, and truncate the result to 60 characters. Empty or whitespace-only input gives an empty string.

The Codex adapter uses it for command_execution tool events (name stays `command`); replaying fixtures/providers/codex/exec-json-tools.sample.jsonl gives the summary `cat AGENTS.md` for the `bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md'` item.

The Claude adapter maps assistant tool_use items named Bash to a provider.tool event with name `bash` and summary shellSummary(input.command, cwd); all other Claude tools keep their current behavior (file_path relative to cwd).

Unit tests for shellSummary cover: wrapper removal with both quote styles, multi-line commands (first line only), `FOO=secret pnpm test` becoming `FOO=… pnpm test`, `export TOKEN=abc123` becoming `export TOKEN=…`, a cwd prefix, a 200-character single word truncated to 60, empty input; plus adapter tests with scripted lines for a Claude Bash tool_use (including one with a secret-looking `API_KEY=sk-test` word) asserting the summary never contains the secret value.
